$comment: Design language, not cars. Every entry describes an era, a set of constraints that produced a
shape, and real proportions in metres — the things that actually steer a generator — plus an
`avoid` list naming what must not appear. Nothing here names a marque, a model or a team: a
prompt that names one gets a copy of that one, which is the outcome this file exists to prevent.
See README.md for why each field is shaped the way it is.
FIELDS. `subject` is the noun the prompt uses, so it must read as a thing and not as a slot name.
`kind` is the ModelDef kind in apps/coast/src/render/models.ts that this replaces, or null with
`newKind: true` for an asset the game has no slot for yet — generating one of those is fine, but
promoting it means adding a ModelDef and putting it in a scene's roadside or landmark list.
`dims` is read by proportion.mjs as well as by the prompt: lengthM/spanM run left-to-right,
widthM and depthM across, and the optional wheelDiameterM, poleHeightM and legHeightM are what
turn a plain envelope box into a drawing with the right mass in the right place.
KEEP CUES SHORT. generate.mjs budgets the prompt at 1800 characters and gives way at the END of
the cue list when it runs over, loudly. Six or seven cues is the working size; a spec with twelve
is not a richer spec, it is a spec whose last five lines were never read.

backgrounds.green: flat chroma-green #2ecc40, evenly lit, no gradient, no shadow cast on it, no ground under the object
backgrounds.magenta: saturated chroma-magenta #ff00ff, evenly lit, no gradient, no shadow cast on it, no ground under the object

$chroma: Green for everything except vegetation, and magenta for that. A leaf on a green screen is the
one case where the backdrop and the subject are the same colour: the first palm generation came
back with BROWN fronds, because the prompt has to say the object is never the key colour and the
model obeyed. Magenta costs nothing and asks nothing of the plant. Per-spec `chroma` overrides
the class default — put a red car on green, never on magenta.
defaults.camera: camera level with the subject's mid-height, no perspective distortion, the whole object in frame with a small margin
defaults.render: clean studio product photograph, flat even lighting, no cast shadow, matte finish, no motion blur, no lens flare
avoid: manufacturer badges, marque emblems, grille crests or wordmarks of any kind
real sponsor marks, oil-company colours, cigarette-brand liveries
model names or type numbers anywhere on the body
licence plates bearing real jurisdictions
watermarks, signatures, captions, UI, borders

a tall upright tail fin or swan-neck wing

a roll hoop protruding above the roofline
any racing number or roundel; liveries are applied separately
